issues.description: Suspicious `fix.text: '0deg'` in new reject fixtures looks like a copy-paste artifact.
issues.detail: Two new reject cases set `fix.text` to `'0deg'` while the fixed output ends in `'10deg'`/`'1deg'`. The same shape appears elsewhere so it may be framework semantics for range insertion, but two reviewers independently flagged it as worth confirming the harness isn't silently ignoring `fix.text`.

issues.description: `args[0 + offset]` reads as noise; use `args[offset]` or a named hue index.
issues.detail: The `0 + offset` is cleverness-by-symmetry that costs reader attention for nothing. Either drop the zero (`args[offset]`) or precompute `hueIndex` and use it on both branches. Tiny patch, tiny fix, but every line should earn its place.

issues.description: Missing reject coverage for nested relative-color where the outer hue also needs fixing.
issues.detail: Accept fixtures cover `oklch(from hsl(270deg 60% 50%) l c h)`, but no reject case exercises a function whose `from` origin is itself a color function AND whose outer hue requires the fix. One nested reject case locks the recursive postcondition of `findHue` across nesting.

issues.description: Relative-color detection conflates `from` prefix with channel triple via inline offset arithmetic.
issues.detail: `args` mixes the optional `from <origin>` prefix with the channel list, and `findHue` papers over it with an inline offset. A small helper (e.g. `{funcName: hueIndex}` table plus a `relativeOffset(args)` returning `{channels}`) would localize the shape and make future relative-color variants substitutable without index gymnastics.

synthesis.summary: The panel accepts the patch: it is small, scoped, and correctly shifts the hue-channel index by 2 when relative-color `from` syntax is present, with appropriate accept/reject test coverage. The main concrete concern is a suspicious `fix.text: '0deg'` in the new reject fixtures that two reviewers want verified against the test harness. Stylistic cleanup (`args[0 + offset]` -> `args[offset]`) and a nested-relative-color reject case would tighten the change. The deeper architectural note — that `findHue` lacks a written contract and conflates the `from` prefix with the channel list — is worth a small helper but not a blocker.
